verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents a built-in embedding API with a function registry supporting multiple providers (OpenAI registered by default, VoyageAI, OpenCLIP for multimodal) plus custom embedding function definitions, letting embeddings be generated automatically at ingest and query time without a separate pipeline. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the ingest+query embedding workflow and broader provider coverage details beyond the few named examples.
